# LargerSieve — Gallagher's larger sieve: when each wheel leaves few positions

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proved in Lean · **Diagram:** [Sieve methods: Brun, Hooley, Selberg](../../GRAPH.md#sieve-methods-brun-hooley-selberg)

If a set of numbers in a window of length N occupies at most g(q) positions on each wheel q (prime powers allowed), then its size is at most the sum of log q minus log N, over the sum of log q over g(q) minus log N, whenever the denominator is positive. So when every wheel leaves at most G positions open and the wheels are numerous enough, fewer than G numbers survive. Elementary: counting pairs that agree on a wheel. Gallagher 1971. As proved: matches the plan, with the von Mangoldt weight (log of the prime for a prime power, 0 otherwise) on any finite set of wheel sizes.

## Claims

<a id="larger_sieve"></a>
### `larger_sieve`

A set in a window of length N occupying few positions on weighted wheels has at most (total weight - log N)/(sum of weight over occupied positions - log N) members.

```lean
/-- **Gallagher's larger sieve.** For a set `A` inside a window of length `N`
(`M ≤ a < M + N`) and any finite set `S` of wheel sizes, weighted by the von
Mangoldt function: if the sum of weight over occupied positions exceeds
`log N`, then `A` has at most (total weight − log N) / (sum of weight over
occupied positions − log N) members. -/
def larger_sieve : Prop :=
  ∀ (A S : Finset Nat) (M N : Nat), (∀ a ∈ A, M ≤ a ∧ a < M + N) →
    Real.log N < ∑ q ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt q / (classes A q : ℝ) →
    (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (∑ q ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt q - Real.log N) /
      (∑ q ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt q / (classes A q : ℝ) - Real.log N)
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.LargerSieve.larger_sieve_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/LargerSieve.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/LargerSieve.lean)

<a id="larger_sieve_few"></a>
### `larger_sieve_few`

If every wheel leaves at most G positions open, the set has at most (total weight - log N)/(total weight/G - log N) members.

```lean
/-- **Few open positions on every wheel.** If `A` occupies at most `G ≥ 1`
positions on every wheel of `S` and the total weight over `G` exceeds
`log N`, then `A` has at most (total weight − log N) / (total weight / G −
log N) members. -/
def larger_sieve_few : Prop :=
  ∀ (A S : Finset Nat) (M N G : Nat), (∀ a ∈ A, M ≤ a ∧ a < M + N) → 1 ≤ G →
    (∀ q ∈ S, classes A q ≤ G) →
    Real.log N < (∑ q ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt q) / G →
    (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (∑ q ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt q - Real.log N) /
      ((∑ q ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt q) / G - Real.log N)
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.LargerSieve.larger_sieve_few_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/LargerSieve.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/LargerSieve.lean)
